questions.text: Which instrument is the girl going to learn to play?
questions.text_cn: 女孩打算学习哪种乐器？
questions.explanation: 原文: "My cousin's just given me his old guitar, so I thought I'd try and teach myself that." 解析: 女孩说她的表哥给了她一把旧吉他，她想试着自学吉他。

questions.text: Which programme are they going to watch?
questions.explanation: 原文: "I was kind of hoping to watch that programme on classical music. It'd be really useful for my project that's due next week..." 解析: 女孩希望观看古典音乐节目，因为这会对她下周要交的作业很有帮助。

questions.text: Which picture shows the girl's cousin?
questions.text_cn: 哪张图片显示了女孩的表弟？
questions.explanation: 原文: "Well both boys are wearing trainers. Look ... But yes, that's Jerry on the right." 解析: 男孩问照片里穿运动鞋的是不是女孩的表弟，女孩确认了，说是右边那个Jerry。

questions.text: Which part of the boy's leg is painful?
questions.explanation: 原文: "It's more my ankle rather than my heel. It really hurts and it's hard to walk." 解析: 男孩说是他的脚踝，而不是脚后跟疼。

questions.text: How much money should students take on the trip?
questions.text_cn: 学生们应该带多少钱去旅行？
questions.explanation: 原文: "However, I do recommend you bring twelve pounds in cash." 解析: 建议带12英镑的现金。

questions.text: Which picture is the teacher talking about?
questions.explanation: 原文: "The ones with two spots next to each other, like this one, are more common in warmer climates...you'll see a similar type of butterfly – one with spots on the top and the bottom of its wings." 解析: 老师描述的蝴蝶，是两个点连在一起的，并且在后面的课程会讲到相似的蝴蝶，那种蝴蝶翅膀的顶部和底部都有点。

questions.text: What has the girl learned how to make?
questions.explanation: 原文: "The last thing we did was apple pie, which was harder than I thought it'd be." 解析: 女孩说，他们上次做的是苹果派，比她想象的要难。
